title: A Donkey Burger and Many Channels
titleRu: Бурге́р с осло́м и мно́го кана́лов
description: Steven explains why he runs so many channels and talks about his first steps with TikTok live streams. He also covers simple life in Beijing: a donkey burger, his favourite foods, the new drone ban, gym progress on creatine, and a line from American Gods about what home means.

sentences.en: Short summary
Steven is Canadian.
He lives in Beijing.
He makes a podcast every day.

sentences.zh: Сего́дня он рассказывает, зачем ему́ так мно́го кана́лов.
sentences.en: Today he explains why he has so many channels.

sentences.zh: Потом он говори́т о про́стой жи́зни в Пеки́не.
sentences.en: Then he talks about simple life in Beijing.

sentences.zh: Не все лю́бят слу́шать про иску́сственный интелле́кт.
sentences.en: Not everyone likes listening about artificial intelligence.

sentences.zh: Поэ́тому Стивен расска́жет и о друго́м.
sentences.en: So Steven will also talk about other things.

sentences.zh: Он купи́л бурге́р с мя́сом осла́.
sentences.en: He bought a donkey meat burger.

sentences.zh: Он рассказа́л, каку́ю еду́ он лю́бит.
sentences.en: He talked about what food he likes.

sentences.zh: Он говори́т и о но́вых прави́лах для дро́нов.
sentences.en: He also talks about the new rules for drones.

sentences.zh: Ещё он по́дняэт шта́нгу и ра́дуется.
sentences.en: He also lifts a barbell and is happy.

sentences.zh: В конце́ он чита́ет кни́гу и ду́мает о до́ме.
sentences.en: At the end he reads a book and thinks about home.
Why so many channels?

sentences.zh: Лю́ди спра́шивают: «Стив, почему́ ты не де́лаешь оди́н кана́л?»
sentences.en: People ask: "Steve, why don't you do just one channel?"
Steven answers honestly.
He doesn't trust a single channel.

sentences.zh: Он не хо́чет жить на одну́ зарпла́ту.
sentences.en: He doesn't want to live on one salary.
It's the same with channels.
You need several.

sentences.zh: Ра́ньше он ча́сто мон та́жировал ви́део.
sentences.en: He used to edit videos often.

sentences.zh: Тепе́рь он почти́ не мон та́жирует.
sentences.en: Now he hardly edits at all.

sentences.zh: У него́ мно́го рабо́ты и опы́тов с иску́сственным интелле́ктом.
sentences.en: He has a lot of work and experiments with artificial intelligence.

sentences.zh: Если вы́брать то́лько оди́н кана́л, Стивен возьмёт подка́ст.
sentences.en: If he had to pick just one channel, Steven would take the podcast.
Making videos is very hard.

sentences.zh: А подка́ст он де́лает с любо́вью.
sentences.en: But he makes the podcast with love.
It helps him think out loud.
The "I Want It Perfect" Disease
Steven started writing on Substack.

sentences.zh: Ра́ньше ему́ нра́вилось писа́ть в блог.
sentences.en: He used to like writing on his blog.
But then came the "epic disease."
Here's how it works.
You see all the mistakes.
You stop.

sentences.zh: Тебе́ ма́ло, что́бы бы́ло про́сто хорошо́.
sentences.en: It's not enough for you that it's just good.
You need it to be magnificent.

sentences.zh: Стивен говори́т: «Нужно опубликова́ть, что́бы пойти́ да́льше».
sentences.en: Steven says: "You have to publish in order to move on."

sentences.zh: Тепе́рь он игра́ет с «аге́нтами» иску́сственного интелле́кта.
sentences.en: Now he's playing with AI "agents."
These are just helper programs.

sentences.zh: Мно́гие слу́шатели — иностра́нцы в Кита́е и учителя́ англи́йского.
sentences.en: Many listeners are foreigners in China and English teachers.

sentences.zh: Стивен шу́тит: «Если ты хо́чешь, что́бы компью́тер де́лал твою́ рабо́ту, этот подка́ст для тебя́».
sentences.en: Steven jokes: "If you want a computer to do your work, this podcast is for you."
TikTok and the start of the podcast

sentences.zh: Стивен тепе́рь вы́ходит в пряно́й эфи́р в TikTok.
sentences.en: Steven now goes live on TikTok.
He is still learning.

sentences.zh: Вчера́ у него́ не́ было ни одного́ ла́йка.
sentences.en: Yesterday he didn't have a single like.
Then suddenly there were 631.

sentences.zh: На YouTube прямо́й эфи́р не получа́лся.
sentences.en: On YouTube the live stream didn't work out.
From China the connection there is weak.
On TikTok everything goes better.
He started the podcast in 2021.
Back then there was COVID.

sentences.zh: Ему́ ну́жно бы́ло не сойти́ с ума́.
sentences.en: He needed to keep from going crazy.
A burger with donkey meat
Now about life.

sentences.zh: В суббо́ту Стивен шёл из спортза́ла.
sentences.en: On Saturday Steven was walking home from the gym.

sentences.zh: Он зашёл в кафе́ с бурге́рами из осла́.
sentences.en: He stopped by a café with donkey burgers.

sentences.zh: Оно́ ря́дом с нало́говой инспе́кцией, на ули́це Дава́нлу.
sentences.en: It's next to the tax office, on Dawanlu Street.
The meat tastes ordinary.
The bun is long.
Inside there's pork fat, onion and pepper.
Tasty!

sentences.zh: Но Стивен ду́мал, что бурге́р сто́ит 12 или 15 юаней.
sentences.en: But Steven thought the burger cost 12 or 15 yuan.
But it cost 20 yuan.
Maybe it's just inflation.
That's when everything gets more expensive.
His Canadian friend moved to Fujian.
The friend says: "Go out and walk around the city!"
But Steven has lived here for 12 years.

sentences.zh: Он лу́чше бу́дет настра́ивать свои́ програ́ммы.
sentences.en: He'd rather work on setting up his programs.

sentences.zh: Он не хо́чет, что́бы на него́ смотре́ли и фотографи́ровали на у́лице.
sentences.en: He doesn't want people staring at him and taking photos of him on the street.
Don't think the beard is to blame.
It's almost 50 centimeters long.
But it was like that before too.
Favorite food

sentences.zh: У Стивена коро́ткий спи́сок люби́мой еды́:
sentences.en: Steven has a short list of favorite foods:

sentences.zh: Кита́йский за́втрак: ба́оцзы, юти́ао и доуцзя́н
sentences.en: Chinese breakfast: baozi, youtiao and soy milk

sentences.zh: Гоба́ожоу: хру́сткая сла́дко-ки́слая свини́на с Се́веро-Восто́ка
sentences.en: Guobaorou: crispy sweet-and-sour pork from the Northeast

sentences.zh: Мусульма́нский шашлы́к: как настоя́щий сте́йк на па́лочке
sentences.en: Muslim kebabs: like a real steak on a stick

sentences.zh: Двойно́й бурге́р в Blue Frog: по мне́нию Стивена, лу́чшие бурге́ры в ми́ре
sentences.en: The double burger at Blue Frog: in Steven's opinion, the best burgers in the world

sentences.zh: В Blue Frog в понеде́льник «два по цене́ одного́».
sentences.en: On Mondays, Blue Frog has "two for the price of one."

sentences.zh: Два бурге́ра и два напи́тка сто́ят 160 юаней.
sentences.en: Two burgers and two drinks cost 160 yuan.
That's more than 30 Canadian dollars.

sentences.zh: Смешно́, как меня́ется счёт за грани́цей.
sentences.en: It's funny how your sense of money changes abroad.
Here he thinks: "Of course I'll get it!"

sentences.zh: А в Кана́де 30 до́лларов — э́то тру́дно отда́ть.
sentences.en: But in Canada, 30 dollars is hard to part with.

sentences.zh: Ма́ма его́ подру́ги ча́сто присыла́ет еду́.
sentences.en: His girlfriend's mom often sends food.
The best is tianbing.
It's a sweet flatbread.

sentences.zh: Её гре́ют и едя́т с моро́женым.
sentences.en: You warm it up and eat it with ice cream.
It makes a wonderful dessert.
Autumn and the drone ban
The leaves are finally yellow.

sentences.zh: Осенью хорошо́ е́хать на Вели́кую сте́ну.
sentences.en: Autumn is a good time to go to the Great Wall.

sentences.zh: Ра́ньше можно бы́ло снять кра́сивое ви́део с дро́на.
sentences.en: Before, you could shoot a beautiful video from a drone.

sentences.zh: Тепе́рь в Пеки́не нельзя́ име́ть дрон и его́ ча́сти.
sentences.en: Now in Beijing you're not allowed to own a drone or its parts.

sentences.zh: Нельзя́ и везти́ их, да́же в транспорте.
sentences.en: You can't transport them either, even on public transit.

sentences.zh: Стивен слы́шал, что запре́т — на 300 киломе́тров во́круг го́рода.
sentences.en: Steven heard that the ban covers 300 kilometres around the city.

sentences.zh: А е́сли ты лети́шь из Кана́ды в Монго́лию и пересе́дешь в Пеки́не?
sentences.en: And what if you're flying from Canada to Mongolia and change planes in Beijing?
Steven didn't find an answer.

sentences.zh: Ему́ трево́жно: у него́ ещё есть дрон.
sentences.en: He's anxious: he still has a drone.
The gym and creatine
There are two options at the gym.
You can put money on a card.
Or buy a monthly membership.
The downside of the membership is this.

sentences.zh: Вы́шел в туале́т или забы́л буты́лку?
sentences.en: Did you step out to the bathroom or forget your bottle?
You lose the entry.
Steven hasn't decided yet.
He needs a week of rest.
He showed his bottle.
There's creatine in it.
It's a powder for muscles.
Three grams a day.

sentences.zh: Ра́ньше у него́ боле́л живо́т, наверное, от молочного бе́лка.
sentences.en: He used to get stomachaches, probably from milk protein.

sentences.zh: Поэтому он тепе́рь пьёт горо́ховый бело́к.
sentences.en: So now he drinks pea protein.

sentences.zh: Стивен ду́мает, что креати́н даёт ему́ си́лу на тренировки.
sentences.en: Steven thinks creatine gives him strength for his workouts.
Here are his results:
Bench press: 80 kilograms.
First four reps, then three.
That's almost his body weight.
That was the first time in 10 years.

sentences.zh: Ста́новая тя́га: 130 килогра́ммов, оди́н раз, с по́ясом
sentences.en: Deadlift: 130 kilograms, one rep, with a belt
Squats: about 80 kilograms
Steven jokes: "Not bad for an old man."

sentences.zh: Но он совсе́м не о́чень ста́рый.
sentences.en: But he's not really that old at all.
Books instead of beer
Steven goes to the bar less.
He reads.

sentences.zh: После па́ры кру́жек пи́ва он смо́трит ролики и мульти́к «Гриффи́ны».
sentences.en: After a couple of mugs of beer, he watches videos and the cartoon "Family Guy".
And the books get in the way in the apartment.

sentences.zh: Он говори́т: «Если пи́во тебе́ ми́лее кни́ги, то, мо́жет, отда́й кни́гу».
sentences.en: He says: "If beer is dearer to you than books, then maybe give the book away."
He finally finished reading "American Gods".
Next is "Love Is a Mix Tape" by Rob Sheffield.
He bought it for a friend.
He thought it was about love.
But it turned out to be about death.
Oops!

sentences.zh: Бли́зко к концу́ «Америка́нских бого́в» есть стро́чка.
sentences.en: Near the end of "American Gods" there is a line.
Steven stopped.

sentences.zh: В ней говори́тся так: дом — э́то то, что случа́ется с ме́стом через вре́мя?
sentences.en: It goes like this: is home what happens to a place over time?

sentences.zh: Или э́то то, что нахо́дишь, е́сли до́лго идёшь, ждёшь и о́чень хо́чешь?
sentences.en: Or is it what you find if you walk for a long time, wait, and really want it?
This is the life of expats.
Do you choose your home yourself?
Or is it given to you?
The main thing
Steven does a lot of things at once.
Maybe this isn't very clear.

sentences.zh: Но так он узнаёт, что получа́ется.
sentences.en: But that's how he finds out what works.

sentences.zh: Ино́гда са́мая ску́чная жизнь за грани́цей прино́сит вку́сные бурге́ры.
sentences.en: Sometimes the most boring life abroad brings tasty burgers.

sentences.zh: И стро́чку из кни́ги, кото́рую не забу́дешь.
sentences.en: And a line from a book that you won't forget.

sentences.zh: Мо́жет, дом — э́то то, во что превраща́ется ме́сто, когда́ ты там до́лго живёшь.
sentences.en: Maybe home is what a place turns into when you live there for a long time.
